records.target_text: Connect tables, graphs, equations or rules, and contexts that represent the same relationship.
records.primary_i_can: Multiple current-section Intro I Can statements are intentionally connected in one routine.
records.evidence_job: Track the same relationship across table, coordinate plane, and rule without formalizing every conversion at once.
records.student_action: Work through four labeled connected parts around one shared stimulus; later parts must use information or representations established earlier.

representation_route.contract: Render a semantic HTML <table> with headers and readable row/column alignment.

records.difficulty_intent: preview/decomposition: accessible enough for productive entry before formal instruction; difficulty comes from connecting representations/steps, not advanced procedure
records.shared_stimulus: A small relationship shown as a context plus a compact value table.

parts_plan.label: a
parts_plan.move: Locate two matching input-output values in the table/context.

parts_plan.label: b
parts_plan.move: Place those values as ordered pairs on a coordinate grid.

parts_plan.label: c
parts_plan.move: Use the visible pattern to predict one additional pair.

parts_plan.label: d
parts_plan.move: Explain what evidence shows the representations belong to the same relationship.

records.primary_i_can: Multiple current-section Intro I Can statements are intentionally connected in one routine.
records.evidence_job: Decompose input/output language, rule use, ordered-pair recording, and the one-output-per-input idea.
records.student_action: Work through four labeled connected parts around one shared stimulus; later parts must use information or representations established earlier.

representation_route.contract: Render a semantic HTML <table> with headers and readable row/column alignment.

records.difficulty_intent: preview/decomposition: accessible enough for productive entry before formal instruction; difficulty comes from connecting representations/steps, not advanced procedure
records.shared_stimulus: A simple input-output machine/rule with a short table containing one blank.

parts_plan.label: a
parts_plan.move: Identify which quantity is the input and which is the output.

parts_plan.label: b
parts_plan.move: Use the rule to fill one missing output.

parts_plan.label: c
parts_plan.move: Record two rows as ordered pairs.

parts_plan.label: d
parts_plan.move: Decide whether the shown relationship behaves as a function and explain the key reason.

records.difficulty_intent: preview/decomposition: accessible enough for productive entry before formal instruction; difficulty comes from connecting representations/steps, not advanced procedure
records.shared_stimulus: A compact set of four related mini-representations (table/equation/graph descriptions) chosen to make family behavior visible.

parts_plan.label: a
parts_plan.move: Describe what changes by a constant amount or factor in one representation.

parts_plan.label: b
parts_plan.move: Match a second representation to the same broad behavior.

parts_plan.label: c
parts_plan.move: Choose the most likely family for one case and cite evidence.

parts_plan.label: d
parts_plan.move: Predict one next value/feature and explain how the family behavior supports the prediction.

records.target_text: Read, evaluate, and rewrite expressions without changing their value.
records.primary_i_can: Multiple current-section Intro I Can statements are intentionally connected in one routine.
records.evidence_job: Preview structure by connecting parts of an expression, legal rewriting, and value preservation.
records.student_action: Work through four labeled connected parts around one shared stimulus; later parts must use information or representations established earlier.

representation_route.contract: Render equations/expressions with MathJax; no representation is claimed beyond the mathematical expression.

records.difficulty_intent: preview/decomposition: accessible enough for productive entry before formal instruction; difficulty comes from connecting representations/steps, not advanced procedure
records.shared_stimulus: One expression shown in original and partially rewritten forms, with a substitution value available.

parts_plan.label: a
parts_plan.move: Identify a term/coefficient/factor requested in the shared expression.

parts_plan.label: b
parts_plan.move: Substitute the given value into the expression.

parts_plan.label: c
parts_plan.move: Complete one combine-like-terms or distributive rewrite.

parts_plan.label: d
parts_plan.move: Explain how you could check that the rewritten expression keeps the same value.

records.evidence_job: Preview modeling as a chain from variable meaning to equation to solution interpretation.
records.student_action: Work through four labeled connected parts around one shared stimulus; later parts must use information or representations established earlier.

representation_route.contract: Render equations/expressions with MathJax; no representation is claimed beyond the mathematical expression.

records.difficulty_intent: preview/decomposition: accessible enough for productive entry before formal instruction; difficulty comes from connecting representations/steps, not advanced procedure
records.shared_stimulus: A short real situation with two quantities and a simple equation model that can be built from the context.

parts_plan.label: a
parts_plan.move: Define a variable for the unknown quantity.

parts_plan.label: b
parts_plan.move: Write an equation that matches the situation.

parts_plan.label: c
parts_plan.move: Use equivalent steps to find the requested value.

parts_plan.label: d
parts_plan.move: Interpret the solution using the quantities and units from the original situation.
